name: Bloodscalp Ears
summary: In Booty Bay, Bloodscalp Ears bring Kebok a way to answer for mounting losses. He pays for proof of a kill after clashes with the Bloodscalp tribe have cost him guards and agents.

sections.title: Mounting Costs
sections.body: In Stranglethorn Vale, Bloodscalp trolls are killing Kebok's agents and guards. Many of his best guards have fallen in jungle skirmishes. The mounting costs leave him anxious about explaining them to Baron Revilgaz.

sections.title: A Bounded Bounty
sections.body: Kebok offers coin to travelers who hunt Bloodscalp trolls in the jungle. He asks you to bring back fifteen severed ears as proof of the kills.

faq.answer: Kebok is a goblin in Booty Bay whose agents and guards work in the jungle. He must answer to Baron Revilgaz for their costs.

faq.q: Why does Kebok want Bloodscalp ears?
faq.answer: Bloodscalp trolls have killed Kebok's agents and many of his best guards in jungle skirmishes. The costs are mounting, and he must answer to Baron Revilgaz for them.
Kebok asks you to bring him fifteen Bloodscalp ears before he pays you.

faq.q: Where does this bounty lead next?
faq.answer: After Kebok pays you for the Bloodscalp ears, he turns to another local threat: Skullsplitter Tusks.
